messages:
incident-bot: Pager — billing-collector: token_count aggregation skew detected for EU region. Drift=+28% vs baseline. Alerting onage_flags and delayed-emit > 5m.

amanda-ops: seeing same in dashboard. lots of delayed batches from kafka-consumer-eu-02.

oncall-sre: @amanda-ops thanks. I'm taking pager. switching to triage channel.

leo-eng: quick note — ingestion lambda retries spiked around 02:12 UTC, consumer lag ~14k. suspect duplicate batching in the windowing logic.

paul-finance: what customers are impacted? any customer-facing overage emails fired?

sara-support: support queue has two tickets from customer-ID 712 and 893 reporting unexpected overage flags since 02:30 UTC. holding on responses pending root cause.

mike-devex: cp'd logs: ```sh
kubectl logs billing-collector-5 -n prod --since=30m | grep emit_batch | tail -40
# shows repeated batch_ids with same token totals
```

leo-eng: that suggests aggregator dedupe failed. I can push a hotfix to skip processing when batch_id seen recently. preparing PR.

oncall-sre: mitigation plan: 1) pause emitter job to stop further wrong emits 2) replay clean batches from retention store 3) block auto-overage notifications until recon complete. implement now?

amanda-ops: pausing emitter (ci-runbook step) — running: `bin/infractl job pause billing-emitter-eu`

incident-bot: action — job billing-emitter-eu paused by amanda-ops at 02:45:18 UTC.

mike-devex: PR created: https://git.redwood/infra/billing/+/2345 — small guard on batch_id dedupe + metrics. running canary on staging.

leo-eng: canary looks green for 10m. plan to roll to prod in 2m with 1 pod at a time.

paul-finance: please confirm we will not bill duplicate tokens during this window. we need a list of affected customers for crediting if necessary.

sara-support: I'm drafting templated message to hold for impacted customers. will only send after finance ok.

oncall-sre: rolling patch to prod now. monitoring emitter backlog and billing-metering topic offsets.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: rolling deploy billing-aggregator v1.4.7 -> v1.4.8 started by leo-eng at 02:52:03 UTC.

mike-devex: deploy finished on 3/3 pods. alpha metric: duplicate_emit_count decreased to 0; token_delta trend returning to baseline.

amanda-ops: replay started from retention cursor 2026-03-17T01:50Z. replaying clean batches into ingestion-queue. ETA ~18m.

paul-finance: request export of emitted token deltas between 02:00-03:10 UTC. I'll run customer impact query and propose credits.

leo-eng: exporting now: `python tools/export_token_deltas.py --start 2026-03-17T02:00Z --end 2026-03-17T03:10Z --region eu --out /tmp/token_deltas.csv`

sara-support: holding messages. will notify once paul signs off.

oncall-sre: keeping page open for now. will close after final reconciliation and suppression of auto-notifications confirmed.

incident-bot: metric update — token_count_drift down to +2% at 03:05 UTC. delayed_emit queue length decreasing.

paul-finance: reviewed export. 36 customers had transient +1-3% token bump; 5 customers had >10% spikes (IDs redacted in this channel). recommending automatic crediting for the 5 above and a general apology note for the rest.

amanda-ops: auto-notifications re-enabled?

oncall-sre: not yet. suppressing outbound overage emails until credits are posted. message bus suppression rule applied.

sara-support: applying hold-hold to support macros so we don't send manual notices by mistake.

mike-devex: adding regression test to CI to prevent duplicate batch processing. ticket #INF-987.

paul-finance: going to schedule credits. will follow up with amounts and customer list in #billing-ops.

leo-eng: postmortem checklist: root cause = dedupe cache eviction race + retry bursts from consumer; fix deployed; replay + credits in progress; follow-up: add stronger idempotency and monitoring alarm for duplicate_emit_count > 1 for 5m.

oncall-sre: agreed. closing page once credits posted and overage_flags cleared.

incident-bot: note — page closed by oncall-sre at 03:18:60 UTC (monitoring metrics stable).

sara-support: follow-ups: customer comms template ready, will send once paul posts credits.

paul-finance: credits queued. will confirm when processed. great job team. :thumbsup:
